checks.stdout:
name: lexrag-stage3-acceptance
services:
  api:
    build:
      context: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      target: api
    command:
      - uvicorn
      - api:app
      - --host
      - 0.0.0.0
      - --port
      - "8000"
      - --workers
      - "2"
    depends_on:
      bootstrap:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
        required: true
      migrate:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
        required: true
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    environment:
      APP_MODE: production
      AUTH_COOKIE_SAMESITE:[REDACTED_SECRET]
      AUTH_COOKIE_SECURE:[REDACTED_SECRET]
      CHROMA_PERSIST_DIRECTORY: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
      DATABASE_URL: [REDACTED_URL]
      DOCUMENT_UPLOADS_PATH: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
      EMBEDDING_PROVIDER: local
      JWT_SECRET_KEY:[REDACTED_SECRET]
      LAW_GRAPH_PATH: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
      LAW_UPDATE_SNAPSHOT_DIR: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
      LOCAL_EMBEDDING_MODEL_PATH: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
      OPEN_REGISTRATION: "false"
      REDIS_URL: [REDACTED_URL]
      RUNTIME_LLM_TRUSTED_BASE_URLS: [REDACTED_URL]
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - curl
        - -fsS
        - [REDACTED_URL]
      timeout: 5s
      interval: 20s
      retries: 6
      start_period: 30s
    networks:
      lexrag_private: null
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: lexrag_chroma
        target: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
        volume: {}
      - type: volume
        source: lexrag_uploads
        target: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
        volume: {}
      - type: volume
        source: lexrag_graphs
        target: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
        volume: {}
      - type: volume
        source: lexrag_law_snapshots
        target: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
        volume: {}
      - type: bind
        source: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
        target: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
        read_only: true
        bind: {}
  beat:
    build:
      context: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      target: api
    command:
      - celery
      - -A
      - app.tasks.celery_app.celery_app
      - beat
      - --loglevel=INFO
      - --pidfile=[REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
      - --schedule=[REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
    depends_on:
      bootstrap:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
        required: true
      migrate:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
        required: true
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    environment:
      APP_MODE: production
      AUTH_COOKIE_SAMESITE:[REDACTED_SECRET]
      AUTH_COOKIE_SECURE:[REDACTED_SECRET]
      CHROMA_PERSIST_DIRECTORY: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
      DATABASE_URL: [REDACTED_URL]
      DOCUMENT_UPLOADS_PATH: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
      EMBEDDING_PROVIDER: local
      JWT_SECRET_KEY:[REDACTED_SECRET]
      LAW_GRAPH_PATH: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
      LAW_UPDATE_SNAPSHOT_DIR: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
      LOCAL_EMBEDDING_MODEL_PATH: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
      OPEN_REGISTRATION: "false"
      REDIS_URL: [REDACTED_URL]
      RUNTIME_LLM_TRUSTED_BASE_URLS: [REDACTED_URL]
    hostname: beat
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - test -s [REDACTED_HOST_PATH] && kill -0 "$$(cat [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]"
      timeout: 5s
      interval: 20s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    networks:
      lexrag_private: null
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: lexrag_chroma
        target: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
        volume: {}
      - type: volume
        source: lexrag_uploads
        target: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
        volume: {}
      - type: volume
        source: lexrag_graphs
        target: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
        volume: {}
      - type: volume
        source: lexrag_law_snapshots
        target: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
        volume: {}
      - type: bind
        source: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
        target: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
        read_only: true
        bind: {}
  bootstrap:
    build:
      context: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      target: api
    command:
      - python
      - scripts/bootstrap_runtime.py
      - all
      - --json
    depends_on:
      migrate:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
        required: true
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
      volume-init:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
        required: true
    environment:
      APP_MODE: production
      AUTH_COOKIE_SAMESITE:[REDACTED_SECRET]
      AUTH_COOKIE_SECURE:[REDACTED_SECRET]
      CHROMA_PERSIST_DIRECTORY: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
      DATABASE_URL: [REDACTED_URL]
      DOCUMENT_UPLOADS_PATH: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
      EMBEDDING_PROVIDER: local
      JWT_SECRET_KEY:[REDACTED_SECRET]
      LAW_GRAPH_PATH: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
      LAW_UPDATE_SNAPSHOT_DIR: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
      LOCAL_EMBEDDING_MODEL_PATH: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
      OPEN_REGISTRATION: "false"
      REDIS_URL: [REDACTED_URL]
      RUNTIME_LLM_TRUSTED_BASE_URLS: [REDACTED_URL]
    networks:
      lexrag_private: null
    restart: "no"
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: lexrag_chroma
        target: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
        volume: {}
      - type: volume
        source: lexrag_uploads
        target: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
        volume: {}
      - type: volume
        source: lexrag_graphs
        target: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
        volume: {}
      - type: volume
        source: lexrag_law_snapshots
        target: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
        volume: {}
      - type: bind
        source: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
        target: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
        read_only: true
        bind: {}
  migrate:
    build:
      context: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      target: api
    command:
      - alembic
      - upgrade
      - head
    depends_on:
      mysql:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    environment:
      APP_MODE: production
      AUTH_COOKIE_SAMESITE:[REDACTED_SECRET]
      AUTH_COOKIE_SECURE:[REDACTED_SECRET]
      CHROMA_PERSIST_DIRECTORY: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
      DATABASE_URL: [REDACTED_URL]
      DOCUMENT_UPLOADS_PATH: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
      EMBEDDING_PROVIDER: local
      JWT_SECRET_KEY:[REDACTED_SECRET]
      LAW_GRAPH_PATH: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
      LAW_UPDATE_SNAPSHOT_DIR: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
      LOCAL_EMBEDDING_MODEL_PATH: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
      OPEN_REGISTRATION: "false"
      REDIS_URL: [REDACTED_URL]
      RUNTIME_LLM_TRUSTED_BASE_URLS: [REDACTED_URL]
    networks:
      lexrag_private: null
    restart: "no"
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: lexrag_chroma
        target: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
        volume: {}
      - type: volume
        source: lexrag_uploads
        target: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
        volume: {}
      - type: volume
        source: lexrag_graphs
        target: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
        volume: {}
      - type: volume
        source: lexrag_law_snapshots
        target: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
        volume: {}
      - type: bind
        source: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
        target: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
        read_only: true
        bind: {}
  mysql:
    environment:
      MYSQL_DATABASE: lexrag_stage3
      MYSQL_PASSWORD:[REDACTED_SECRET]
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD:[REDACTED_SECRET]
      MYSQL_USER: lexrag
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - mysqladmin ping --protocol=tcp -h 127.0.0.1 -p$$MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD
      timeout: 5s
      interval: 10s
      retries: 15
      start_period: 20s
    image: mysql:8.4
    networks:
      lexrag_private: null
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: lexrag_mysql
        target: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
        volume: {}
  redis:
    command:
      - redis-server
      - --appendonly
      - "yes"
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - redis-cli
        - ping
      timeout: 3s
      interval: 10s
      retries: 10
    image: redis:7-alpine
    networks:
      lexrag_private: null
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: lexrag_redis
        target: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
        volume: {}
  volume-init:
    build:
      context: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      target: api
    command:
      - sh
      - -c
      - chown -R appuser:appuser [REDACTED_HOST_PATH] [REDACTED_HOST_PATH] [REDACTED_HOST_PATH] [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
    networks:
      lexrag_private: null
    restart: "no"
    user: "0:0"
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: lexrag_chroma
        target: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
        volume: {}
      - type: volume
        source: lexrag_uploads
        target: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
        volume: {}
      - type: volume
        source: lexrag_graphs
        target: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
        volume: {}
      - type: volume
        source: lexrag_law_snapshots
        target: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
        volume: {}
  web:
    build:
      context: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    depends_on:
      api:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    networks:
      lexrag_private: null
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        target: 3000
        published: "18080"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: unless-stopped
  worker:
    build:
      context: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      target: api
    command:
      - celery
      - -A
      - app.tasks.celery_app.celery_app
      - worker
      - --loglevel=INFO
      - --concurrency=1
      - --hostname=lexrag-worker@%h
    depends_on:
      bootstrap:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
        required: true
      migrate:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
        required: true
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    environment:
      APP_MODE: production
      AUTH_COOKIE_SAMESITE:[REDACTED_SECRET]
      AUTH_COOKIE_SECURE:[REDACTED_SECRET]
      CHROMA_PERSIST_DIRECTORY: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
      DATABASE_URL: [REDACTED_URL]
      DOCUMENT_UPLOADS_PATH: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
      EMBEDDING_PROVIDER: local
      JWT_SECRET_KEY:[REDACTED_SECRET]
      LAW_GRAPH_PATH: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
      LAW_UPDATE_SNAPSHOT_DIR: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
      LOCAL_EMBEDDING_MODEL_PATH: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
      OPEN_REGISTRATION: "false"
      REDIS_URL: [REDACTED_URL]
      RUNTIME_LLM_TRUSTED_BASE_URLS: [REDACTED_URL]
    hostname: worker
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - python
        - scripts/check_worker_health.py
        - --hostname
        - lexrag-worker@worker
        - --timeout
        - "5"
      timeout: 10s
      interval: 20s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    networks:
      lexrag_private: null
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: lexrag_chroma
        target: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
        volume: {}
      - type: volume
        source: lexrag_uploads
        target: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
        volume: {}
      - type: volume
        source: lexrag_graphs
        target: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
        volume: {}
      - type: volume
        source: lexrag_law_snapshots
        target: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
        volume: {}
      - type: bind
        source: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
        target: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
        read_only: true
        bind: {}
networks:
  lexrag_private:
    name: lexrag-stage3-acceptance_lexrag_private
    driver: bridge
volumes:
  lexrag_chroma:
    name: lexrag-stage3-acceptance_lexrag_chroma
  lexrag_graphs:
    name: lexrag-stage3-acceptance_lexrag_graphs
  lexrag_law_snapshots:
    name: lexrag-stage3-acceptance_lexrag_law_snapshots
  lexrag_mysql:
    name: lexrag-stage3-acceptance_lexrag_mysql
  lexrag_redis:
    name: lexrag-stage3-acceptance_lexrag_redis
  lexrag_uploads:
    name: lexrag-stage3-acceptance_lexrag_uploads
x-runtime-environment:
  APP_MODE: production
  AUTH_COOKIE_SAMESITE:[REDACTED_SECRET]
  AUTH_COOKIE_SECURE:[REDACTED_SECRET]
  CHROMA_PERSIST_DIRECTORY: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
  DATABASE_URL: [REDACTED_URL]
  DOCUMENT_UPLOADS_PATH: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
  EMBEDDING_PROVIDER: local
  JWT_SECRET_KEY:[REDACTED_SECRET]
  LAW_GRAPH_PATH: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
  LAW_UPDATE_SNAPSHOT_DIR: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
  LOCAL_EMBEDDING_MODEL_PATH: [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
  OPEN_REGISTRATION: "false"
  REDIS_URL: [REDACTED_URL]
  RUNTIME_LLM_TRUSTED_BASE_URLS: [REDACTED_URL]
x-runtime-volumes:
  - lexrag_chroma:/app/data/chroma_db
  - lexrag_uploads:/app/data/uploads
  - lexrag_graphs:/app/data/runtime_graphs
  - lexrag_law_snapshots:/app/data/law_snapshots
  - [REDACTED_HOST_PATH]
